title: Immediate Termination for Cause of Network Participation Agreements
content:
Cascade ends an agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements** immediately, with no notice period, on any of these grounds:

- fraud or intentional misrepresentation;
- loss or restriction of license (license action);
- exclusion from a federal health program;
- failure to keep the required professional liability coverage beyond its grace;
- credentialing lapse.

## Consequences

| Element | Effect of a for-cause termination |
|---|---|
| Termination date | The action date, or the last day of the applicable grace |
| Services after the termination date | Out of network |
| Open overpayments of the agreement | Become due for refund |
| A later application by the same provider | The re-application wait for cause applies |

## Notes

- **Which date applies.** Grounds tied to a grace end the agreement on the last day of that grace: failure to keep the required liability coverage, and credentialing lapse. The other grounds end it on the date of the action.
- **Re-application.** After a for-cause termination, the provider may apply again only once the for-cause re-application wait of the agreement type has run.

## Hypothetical illustration

A periodontist's license is suspended on 9 October. The agreement ends that day by license action. A procedure started on 10 October is out of network. Any open overpayment under the agreement becomes due for refund.
